title: Exclusive Sushi-Making Class in Chicago (Includes 3-Course Meal)
blurb:
Discover the fundamentals of sushi-making in Chicago during this immersive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the workshop showcases the precision and artistry of Japanese cuisine.

The menu you will prepare includes:
- Sushi: Spicy ahi-tuna roll with avocado, cucumber and aioli
- Sushi: Shrimp tempura roll with jalapeño, cucumber and miso aioli
- Dessert: Tropical fruit with tōgarashi and honey

With step-by-step guidance from your local sushi chef, you’ll gain confidence in rolling techniques and flavor pairing. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to complement the meal, making the evening both educational and enjoyable.
